$comment: Example: the model connections of a fresh install. Copy this file, put in the address of your model endpoint and your model names, and apply the copy on the server: deploy/bin/memory-admin provision apply - < models.json (add --dry-run first to see what would be written). Each item is written only where nobody has changed the setting. The two connections here use one OpenAI-compatible endpoint; models.allow_open lists both pairs, so open records may be sent to them and closed records are never sent. For a server of your own that may receive closed records too, list the pairs in models.allow_closed instead. The embedding model and its dimension are the documented default (docs/models.md, Recommended models). This file holds no API key: enter the keys in the panel, where they are stored encrypted.
